headline: South Asia: Pakistan Army destroys Afghan Taliban posts in response to firing at Angoor Adda: state media
script:
Good afternoon. This is your global conflict briefing.

ASIA
South Asia - bottom line: Pakistan Army destroys Afghan Taliban posts in response to firing at Angoor Adda: state media.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 9 hours ago: Pakistan Army destroys Afghan Taliban posts in response to firing at Angoor Adda: state media.
Pakistan’s armed forces targeted and destroyed several Afghan Taliban posts and military positions in areas adjacent to South Waziristan and Parachinar, state media reported on Friday, citing security sources. According to state-run Radio Pakistan, the army “gave a befitting reply to unprovoked firing by the Afghan Taliban along the Pak-Afghan border in the Angoor Adda area” on Tuesday. “Using heavy weaponry, the Pakistan Army forced Afghan Taliban personnel to abandon their posts and flee,” the report said.
- Dawn (Pakistan), The Hindu - International, 11 hours ago: Rubio hosts G20 ministers as Iran, Ukraine wars divide members.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will host his G20 counterparts, including Russia’s Sergei Lavrov, for talks on Friday that are expected to be fractious, with wars in Ukraine and Iran and surging energy prices fanning discord. The foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta, Georgia, taking place just days before crucial US midterm elections, will set the stage for a December G20 leaders’ summit in Miami at President Donald Trump’s Doral resort.
- Dawn (Pakistan), Jerusalem Post, Al Jazeera - Middle East, one hour ago: DG ISPR says Pakistan 'cautiously optimistic' on US-Iran mediation.
Pakistan is “cautiously optimistic” about its mediation between Iran and the United States, the military’s spokesman said on Friday in his first interview since a high-level delegation visited Tehran this week. Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir has been to Tehran twice this month, most recently on Monday alongside Saudi and Turkish officials.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 14 hours ago: Cop martyred in KP's Bajaur as terrorists attack police post: official.
BAJAUR: A police officer was martyred after terrorists attacked a police post in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Bajaur district, officials said on Friday. The attack on the police post in Silai Pati area in the remote Barang tehsil, bordering Malakand district, occurred late on Thursday night. Mansoor Khan, a spokesperson for the district police, while confirming the attack, told Dawn that a group of Fitna al-Khawarij terrorists targeted the Silai Pati police post, prompting the personnel to retaliate bravely and courageously.
